name: National Silicon Industry Group Co., Ltd.
summary: National Silicon Industry Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of semiconductor silicon wafers and other high-end semiconductor materials in China and internationally. It offers 200mm and smaller semiconductor silicon wafers, as well as SOI wafers; 300mm semiconductor silicon wafers; and customized silicon wafers. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Shanghai, China.
